reason: Conversation 1 guided the homeowner through the full sensible diagnostic path: unplug first, reseat the container and clean its filter, then look behind the lower cover with a torch where they found the slimy sump, and it correctly read the partial improvement after cleaning as evidence of a contaminated sump while refusing to condemn the pump or float prematurely. It respected the stacked-unit constraint, avoided naming part numbers, and escalated to an engineer with a useful handover description. Conversation 2 was safe and honest but stopped after two turns, never pointed the customer to the accessible pump sump compartment, and so missed the step that actually produced diagnostic progress.
